comments.content: wiremock is only used in integration tests, so it should be a dev-dependency rather than a regular dependency to avoid increasing the size of the uv binary.

Mounting a second Mock with the same method/path/basic_auth conditions without resetting the MockServer leaves the original mock active. Wiremock matches mocks in registration order, so the first mock will continue to be chosen and the updated requirements.txt body / headers may never be served, making the test flaky. Reset the server or use a distinct matcher before mounting the updated mock.
